programs.name: sufctanismod
programs.purpose: Model elastic waves in a two-dimensional anisotropic medium using finite differences and optional flux-corrected transport.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFCTANISMOD - Flux-Corrected Transport correction applied to the 2D

params.name: fctxbeg
params.description: Beginning x index of FCT region.

params.name: fctzbeg
params.description: Beginning z index of FCT region.

params.name: fctxend
params.description: Ending x index of FCT region.

params.name: fctzend
params.description: Ending z index of FCT region.

params.name: suhead
params.description: Write optional seismograms with SU headers when nonzero.

params.name: sfile
params.description: Raw float source grid file; absent uses a constructed source.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Time-stepped coupled elastic fields and FCT corrections accumulate floating-point errors; source wavelets and boundary calculations use exp, sqrt and tan. Some boundary and indexing paths require careful reproduction. The program always creates snapshotx.data, snapshoty.data and snapshotz.data; stdout is the final raw x-component grid. All source-component flags default to zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: The coupled anisotropic solver, FCT correction, multiple boundaries and source options involve complex iterative state.

test_cases.description: Second-order point source with z force and sparse snapshots.
test_cases.command: sufctanismod nx=32 nz=32 nt=40 sx=16 sz=16 indexuz=1 source=1 wavelet=3 mt=4 > final.bin

test_cases.description: Fourth-order propagation with FCT and an SU horizontal receiver file.
test_cases.command: sufctanismod nx=32 nz=32 nt=40 sx=16 sz=16 indexux=1 source=1 wavelet=2 order=4 dofct=1 reflxfile=refl.su receiverdepth=16 mt=4 > final.bin

programs.name: sufdmod1
programs.purpose: Model a one-dimensional acoustic wavefield and record a receiver trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFDMOD1 - Finite difference modelling (1-D 1rst order) for the

params.name: nt
params.default: computed: 1+tmax/dt when omitted or zero; dt=dz/1.414/vmax/2

params.name: velfile
params.description: Raw float velocity file; stdin is used when absent.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Mentioned in selfdoc, but the code does not read this parameter; use velfile.

params.name: sfile
params.description: Output SU receiver trace file; stdout when absent.

params.name: dfile
params.description: Raw float density file; absent uses density 2500.

params.name: abs
params.description: Top and bottom absorbing boundary flags.

params.name: zt
params.description: Mentioned in selfdoc, but the code reads td instead.

params.name: press
params.description: Record pressure when 1, particle velocity when 0.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The iterative pressure and velocity updates depend on accumulation order and mixed float/double expressions; source construction uses exp and sqrt. Snapshot headers are local uninitialized structures and the declared snapshot sample count exceeds the number of samples filled by one, leaving a sample uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: The explicit time-stepping solver maintains coupled pressure and velocity fields and absorbing boundaries.

test_cases.description: Pressure trace from a constant velocity model.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=32 ntr=1 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sufdmod1 nz=32 tmax=0.02 sz=16 dz=10 rz=10 freq=25 < vel.bin > trace.su

test_cases.description: Particle velocity with Ricker source and decimated snapshots.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=32 ntr=1 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sufdmod1 nz=32 tmax=0.02 sz=16 dz=10 rz=10 styp=2 press=0 abs=1,1 td=2 zd=2 wfile=wave.su < vel.bin > trace.su

programs.name: sufdmod2
programs.purpose: Model two-dimensional acoustic wave propagation with an explicit second-order finite-difference scheme.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFDMOD2 - Finite-Difference MODeling (2nd order) for acoustic wave equation

params.name: xs
params.description: Source x coordinates, or an ASCII source-location filename containing a count followed by x,z pairs; pw=1 changes source-count handling.

params.name: zs
params.description: Source z coordinates, required with numeric xs; omitted when xs names a source-location file.

params.name: abs
params.description: Top, left, bottom and right absorbing flags; any supplied count other than four falls back to defaults.

params.name: nt
params.default: computed: 1+tmax/dt when omitted or zero; dt=min(abs(dx),abs(dz))/(2*vmax)

params.name: pwt
params.description: Plane-wave source end taper in grid points.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Explicit time stepping and absorbing boundaries accumulate rounding error; source and interpolation calculations use exp, sqrt, sin and cos. Velocity fread is unchecked. The plane-wave path changes ns to nx before reading source arrays, so supplying fewer coordinates can leave elements uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: The two-dimensional iterative wave solver includes multiple sources, receiver gathers and absorbing boundaries.

test_cases.description: Point source with a horizontal receiver gather.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=32 ntr=32 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sufdmod2 nx=32 nz=32 dx=10 dz=10 tmax=0.04 xs=160 zs=160 fpeak=25 mt=4 hsz=100 hsfile=hs.su < vel.bin > wave.su

test_cases.description: Two sources with free top surface and source-point traces.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=32 ntr=32 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sufdmod2 nx=32 nz=32 dx=10 dz=10 tmax=0.04 xs=120,200 zs=150,150 abs=0,1,1,1 sstrength=2 mono=1 fpeak=20 mt=4 ssfile=ss.su < vel.bin > wave.su

programs.name: sufdmod2_pml
programs.purpose: Model two-dimensional acoustic wave propagation with optional perfectly matched layer boundaries.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFDMOD2_PML - Finite-Difference MODeling (2nd order) for acoustic wave

params.name: zs
params.description: Source z coordinates; count must match xs.

params.name: abs
params.description: Top, left, bottom and right absorbing flags; any supplied count other than four falls back to defaults.

params.name: nt
params.default: computed: 1+tmax/dt when omitted or zero; dt=min(abs(dx),abs(dz))/(2*vmax)

params.name: pml_thick
params.description: Half-thickness of the PML; zero selects traditional boundaries.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The iterative wavefield and PML state accumulate rounding error, and source, interpolation and PML coefficients use exp, sqrt and cos. Velocity fread is unchecked. Source z indices are computed using dx instead of dz. The selfdoc describes the PML implementation as experimental and potentially buggy.
programs.difficulty_reason: The two-dimensional iterative solver adds substantial state and coefficient calculations for PML boundaries.

test_cases.description: Traditional absorbing boundaries with a horizontal gather.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=32 ntr=32 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sufdmod2_pml nx=32 nz=32 dx=10 dz=10 tmax=0.04 xs=160 zs=160 fpeak=25 mt=4 hsz=100 hsfile=hs.su < vel.bin > wave.su

test_cases.description: PML boundaries and a vertical receiver gather.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=32 ntr=32 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sufdmod2_pml nx=32 nz=32 dx=10 dz=10 tmax=0.04 xs=160 zs=160 pml_thick=4 pml_max=500 fpeak=20 mt=4 vsx=100 vsfile=vs.su < vel.bin > wave.su

programs.license_note: PML implementation credited to Michael Holzrichter of TAMU; density-variation corrections credited to Greg Wimpey of CWP/WesternGeco.

programs.name: sugoupillaud
programs.purpose: Calculate the full one-dimensional impulse response of a lossless Goupillaud layered medium.

params.name: tmax
params.default: computed: (2*tr.ns-(l-1)-(k-1))/2 using integer division if k<tr.ns; otherwise k

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Recursive polynomial products and divisions use double precision and order-dependent accumulations before conversion to float output; sqrt is used in the calculations.
programs.difficulty_reason: The full response uses recursive polynomials, divisions and multiple source and receiver configurations.

test_cases.description: Surface source and receiver with a simple reflectivity series.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=1 k1=5 mag=0.2 | sugoupillaud k=1 l=1 tmax=32 > full.su

test_cases.description: Buried pressure source with a deeper receiver.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=1 k1=8 mag=0.2 | sugoupillaud k=6 l=3 pV=-1 tmax=32 > buried.su

programs.license_note: The file has no standard copyright notice; credits Albena Mateeva and identifies polynomial routines as based on Robinson's Fortran subroutines.

programs.name: sugoupillaudpo
programs.purpose: Calculate the primaries-only one-dimensional impulse response of a lossless Goupillaud medium.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGOUPILLAUDPO - calculate Primaries-Only impulse response of a lossless

params.name: tmax
params.default: computed: (n2-n1+2+2*max(max(n1-1,n+1-n2),n+1-n1))/2 using integer division, where n=tr.ns-1, n1=min(k,l), n2=max(k,l)

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Transmission coefficients are accumulated in float precision, so multiplication order and compiler contraction can affect output bits.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program computes multiple primary paths through a layered model and handles source and receiver positions.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=1 k1=5 mag=0.2 | sugoupillaudpo k=1 l=1 tmax=32 > primary.su

test_cases.description: Buried pressure source and receiver at different layers.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=1 k1=8 mag=0.2 | sugoupillaudpo k=6 l=3 pV=-1 tmax=32 > buried.su

programs.license_note: The file has no standard copyright notice; it credits Albena Mateeva.
